landing.ctaText: Seven languages, six CEFR levels and corrections you can understand.
landing.footerAbout: A platform to learn languages by CEFR levels, with local AI used only when it adds value.
landing.levelsTitle: From your first sentences to mastery
landing.levelsLead: The Common European Framework of Reference orders learning in six levels; every course states its own.

levels.A1: Breakthrough: introduce yourself and everyday phrases.
levels.A2: Waystage: routines, shopping and simple conversations.
levels.B1: Threshold: travel, opinions and clear texts.
levels.B2: Vantage: debates, articles and fluency with natives.
levels.C1: Effective proficiency: complex texts and professional use.
levels.C2: Mastery: nuance, irony and near-native precision.

landing.aiTitle: AI runs on the platform server, not in the cloud
landing.aiLead: We use open models with Ollama only when they add value; teacher-approved content comes first.

aiPoints.title: Your texts stay with us
aiPoints.text: Corrector, tutor and Guide Agent use local models: your writing is not sent to external services.

aiPoints.title: Reviewed content first
aiPoints.text: The tutor answers with the approved curriculum; AI only drafts and is always labelled as such.

aiPoints.title: Verifiable certificates
aiPoints.text: The PDF fingerprint is anchored on the Sepolia test network: anyone can check it was not altered.

landing.pricingTitle: Start free, pay only for the course you want
landing.pricingLead: No subscriptions: each paid course is bought once and it is yours.

plans.name: Course
plans.text: To go deep into one language.

landing.paymentNote: Pay by card (Stripe) or with ETH on the Sepolia test network. This is a demo environment: no real money is charged.
landing.faqMore: See all in the Help center →

faqFallback.q: Does the platform charge real money?
faqFallback.a: Not in this environment: payments use Stripe test mode and Sepolia test ETH.

faqFallback.q: When do I get my certificate?
faqFallback.a: When you complete 100 % of the course you request it in "My certificates" and download the verifiable PDF.

faqFallback.q: What is the difference between the AI tutor and the Guide Agent?
faqFallback.a: The tutor teaches the language; the Guide Agent explains how to use the platform and cites the manual.
